section ‹Kleene's Star›

theory Finite_State_Machines_ZF_2 imports Finite_State_Machines_ZF_1

begin

text‹This theory defines the Kleene star $L^*$ of a language $L$ over a finite alphabet $\Sigma$
  and proves its basic properties, including that $L^*$ is the smallest language containing $L$
  and the empty word and closed under concatenation. We then construct an $\epsilon$-NFSA
  that is meant to recognize $L^*$ when $L$ is recognized by a DFSA.›

subsection‹Definition and properties of the Kleene star›

text‹The Kleene star of a language is defined by means of a relation on words. In this section
  we define that relation, define the star as the set of words reachable from the empty word
  by its reflexive-transitive closure, and show that the star is the smallest language that
  contains $L$, contains the empty word and is closed under concatenation.›

text‹For a language $L$ over alphabet $\Sigma$ the relation $R_L$ relates a word $v$
  to every word of the form $x\cdot v$, where $x$ is either a word from $L$ or the empty word.›

definition R_lang
  where "Finite(Σ) ⟹ L {is a language with alphabet}Σ ⟹ R_lang(L,Σ) ={⟨v,w⟩∈Lists(Σ)×Lists(Σ). ∃x∈L∪{0}. w = Concat(x,v)}"

text‹The Kleene star $L^*$ of a language $L$ consists of those words $v$ for which
  the pair $(\emptyset, v)$ is in the reflexive-transitive closure of $R_L$,
  i.e. words that can be built from the empty word by repeatedly prepending words from $L$.›

definition star ("_*⇧_" 90)       
  where "Finite(Σ) ⟹ L {is a language with alphabet}Σ ⟹ L*⇧Σ ≡ {v∈Lists(Σ). ⟨0,v⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*}"

text‹The relation $R_L$ is reflexive on the set of all words over $\Sigma$,
  because $v = \emptyset\cdot v$.›

lemma r_lang_refl:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "L {is a language with alphabet}Σ"
  shows "refl(Lists(Σ),R_lang(L,Σ))"
  unfolding refl_def
proof
  fix v assume v:"v∈Lists(Σ)"
  from v have "⟨v,v⟩∈Lists(Σ)×Lists(Σ)" by auto
  moreover have "v = Concat(0,v)" using concat_empty(2) v unfolding Lists_def by auto
  then have "∃x∈L∪{0}. v = Concat(x,v)" by auto
  ultimately have "⟨v,v⟩ ∈ {⟨v,w⟩∈Lists(Σ)×Lists(Σ). ∃x∈L∪{0}. w = Concat(x,v)}" by auto
  then show "⟨v,v⟩ ∈ R_lang(L,Σ)" using R_lang_def assms(1,2) by auto
qed

text‹The relation $R_L$ is preserved by appending a word on the right: if $u R_L v$
  then $u\cdot w\ R_L\ v\cdot w$. This follows from associativity of concatenation.›

lemma concat_r_lang:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "L {is a language with alphabet}Σ" "⟨u,v⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)" "w∈Lists(Σ)"
  shows "⟨Concat(u,w),Concat(v,w)⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)"
proof-
  from assms(1-3) have uv:"u∈Lists(Σ)" "v∈Lists(Σ)" using R_lang_def by auto
  then have I:"Concat(u,w)∈Lists(Σ)" "Concat(v,w)∈Lists(Σ)" using concat_type assms(4) by auto
  from assms(1-3) obtain x where x:"x∈L∪{0}" "Concat(x,u) = v" using R_lang_def by auto
  from x(2) have A:"Concat(Concat(x,u),w) = Concat(v,w)" by auto
  {
    assume as:"x=0"
    have "0:0→Σ" unfolding Pi_def function_def by auto
    then have l0:"0∈Lists(Σ)" unfolding Lists_def by blast
    with as have "x∈Lists(Σ)" by auto
  }
  moreover
  {
    assume as:"x≠0"
    with x(1) have "x:L" by auto
    with assms(1,2) have "x∈Lists(Σ)" using IsALanguage_def by auto
  } ultimately
  have "x∈Lists(Σ)" by auto
  with uv(1) assms(4) have "Concat(Concat(x,u),w) =Concat(x,Concat(u,w)) " using concat_assoc_lists by auto
  with A have "Concat(v,w) = Concat(x,Concat(u,w))"  by auto
  with x(1) have "∃x∈L∪{0}. Concat(v,w) = Concat(x,Concat(u,w))" by auto
  with I show ?thesis using R_lang_def assms(1,2) by auto
qed

text‹Appending a word on the right is also preserved by the reflexive-transitive closure
  of $R_L$. The proof is by induction on the closure.›

lemma concat_r_lang_2:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "L {is a language with alphabet}Σ" "⟨u,v⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*" "w∈Lists(Σ)"
  shows "⟨Concat(u,w),Concat(v,w)⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*"
proof-
  from assms(3) show ?thesis
  proof(rule rtrancl_induct)
    have "field(R_lang(L,Σ)^*) = field(R_lang(L,Σ))" using rtrancl_field by auto
    then have "field(R_lang(L,Σ)^*) ⊆ Lists(Σ)" using R_lang_def assms(1,2) unfolding field_def by auto
    then have u:"u∈Lists(Σ)" using assms(3) by auto
    with assms(4) have "Concat(u,w)∈Lists(Σ)" using concat_type by auto
    then show "⟨Concat(u,w),Concat(u,w)⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*"
      using r_into_rtrancl r_lang_refl assms(1,2) unfolding refl_def by auto
  next
    fix y z assume as:"⟨u,y⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*"
      "⟨y, z⟩ ∈ R_lang(L, Σ)" "⟨Concat(u, w), Concat(y, w)⟩ ∈ R_lang(L, Σ)^*"
    from as(2) assms(1,2,4) have "⟨Concat(y,w),Concat(z,w)⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)"
      using concat_r_lang by auto
    with as(3) show "⟨Concat(u,w),Concat(z,w)⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*"
      using rtrancl_into_rtrancl by auto
  qed
qed


text‹Every word $v\in L$ is related to the empty word: $\emptyset\ R_L\ v$.›

lemma r_lang_L:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "L {is a language with alphabet}Σ" "v∈L"
  shows "⟨0,v⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)"
proof-
  have "0:0→Σ" unfolding Pi_def function_def by auto
  then have l0:"0∈Lists(Σ)" unfolding Lists_def by blast
  moreover from assms have v:"v∈Lists(Σ)" using IsALanguage_def by auto
  ultimately have "⟨0,v⟩∈Lists(Σ)×Lists(Σ)" by auto
  moreover have "v = Concat(v,0)" using concat_empty(1) v unfolding Lists_def by auto
  with assms(3) have "∃x∈L. v = Concat(x,0)" by auto
  ultimately have "⟨0,v⟩ ∈ {⟨v,w⟩∈Lists(Σ)×Lists(Σ). ∃x∈L∪{0}. w = Concat(x,v)}" by auto
  then show "⟨0,v⟩ ∈ R_lang(L,Σ)" using R_lang_def assms(1,2) by auto
qed

text‹The Kleene star of a language over $\Sigma$ is a language over $\Sigma$.›

corollary L_star_lang:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "L {is a language with alphabet}Σ"
  shows "(L*⇧Σ) {is a language with alphabet}Σ"
  using star_def IsALanguage_def assms by auto

text‹A language $L$ is contained in its Kleene star $L^*$.›

corollary L_in_L_star:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "L {is a language with alphabet}Σ"
  shows "L ⊆ (L*⇧Σ)"
proof
  fix x assume "x∈L"
  with assms have "⟨0,x⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)" using r_lang_L by auto
  then have "⟨0,x⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*" using r_into_rtrancl by auto moreover
  from `x∈L` have "x∈Lists(Σ)" using assms IsALanguage_def by auto
  ultimately show "x∈(L*⇧Σ)" using star_def assms by auto
qed

text‹The empty word is in the Kleene star of any language.›

lemma empty_star:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "L {is a language with alphabet} Σ"
  shows "0∈(L*⇧Σ)"
proof-
  have "0:0→Σ" unfolding Pi_def function_def by auto
  then have l0:"0∈Lists(Σ)" unfolding Lists_def by blast
  then have "⟨0,0⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)" using r_lang_refl assms unfolding refl_def by auto
  then have "⟨0,0⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*" using r_into_rtrancl by auto 
  with l0 have "0∈ {v∈Lists(Σ). ⟨0,v⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*}" by auto moreover
  have "(L*⇧Σ) = {v∈Lists(Σ). ⟨0,v⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*}" using star_def
    assms by auto ultimately
  show ?thesis by auto
qed

text‹The Kleene star $L^*$ is closed under concatenation.›

lemma concat_star:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "L {is a language with alphabet} Σ"
  shows "concat(L*⇧Σ,L*⇧Σ)⊆(L*⇧Σ)"
proof
  have lang:"(L*⇧Σ) {is a language with alphabet}Σ" using assms L_star_lang by auto
  fix x assume "x∈concat(L*⇧Σ,L*⇧Σ)"
  then obtain u v where uv:"u∈(L*⇧Σ)" "v∈(L*⇧Σ)" "x=Concat(u,v)" using concat_def lang by auto
  from uv(2) have vv:"⟨0,v⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*" using star_def assms by auto
  have v:"v∈Lists(Σ)" using uv(2) L_star_lang assms IsALanguage_def by auto
  from uv(1) have uu:"⟨0,u⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*" using star_def assms by auto
  with v have "⟨Concat(0,v),Concat(u,v)⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*" using concat_r_lang_2 assms by auto
  moreover have "Concat(0,v) = v" using v concat_empty(2) unfolding Lists_def by auto
  ultimately have "⟨v,Concat(u,v)⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*" by auto
  with uv(3) have "⟨v,x⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*" by auto
  with vv have I:"⟨0,x⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*" using trans_rtrancl unfolding trans_def by auto
  have u:"u∈Lists(Σ)" using uv(1) L_star_lang assms IsALanguage_def by auto
  with v have "Concat(u,v)∈Lists(Σ)" using concat_type by auto
  with uv(3) have "x∈Lists(Σ)" by auto
  with I show "x∈(L*⇧Σ)" using star_def assms by auto
qed
    
  
text‹Minimality of the Kleene star: if a language $M$ contains $L$ and the empty word
  and is closed under concatenation, then $L^*\subseteq M$.›

lemma star_minimal:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "L {is a language with alphabet} Σ"
  and "L ⊆ M" "M {is a language with alphabet} Σ" "0∈M" "concat(M,M) ⊆ M"
  shows "(L*⇧Σ) ⊆ M"
proof
  have lang:"(L*⇧Σ) {is a language with alphabet}Σ" using assms L_star_lang by auto
  fix x assume x:"x∈(L*⇧Σ)"
  show "x∈M"
  proof (rule rtrancl_induct[where P="λx. x∈M"])
    from assms(5) show "0∈M" by auto
    from x have x:"x∈Lists(Σ)" "⟨0,x⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*" using star_def assms(1,2) by auto
    from x(2) show "⟨0,x⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*" by auto
    fix y z assume as:"⟨0,y⟩:R_lang(L,Σ)^*" "⟨y,z⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)" "y∈M"
    from as(2) obtain q where q:"z=Concat(q,y)" "q∈L∪{0}" "y∈Lists(Σ)" "z∈Lists(Σ)" using R_lang_def assms(1,2) by auto
    {
      assume "q=0"
      then have "Concat(q,y) = Concat(0,y)" by auto
      then have "Concat(q,y) = y" using concat_empty(2) q(3)
        unfolding Lists_def by auto
      with q(1) have "z=y" by auto
      with as(3) have "z∈M" by auto
    } moreover
    {
      assume "q≠0"
      with q(2) have "q:L" by auto
      with assms(3) have "q∈M" by auto
      with as(3) have "Concat(q,y)∈concat(M,M)" using concat_def assms(4) by auto
      with assms(6) have "Concat(q,y)∈M" by auto
      with q(1) have "z∈M" by auto
    }
    ultimately show "z:M" by auto
  qed
qed

text‹The Kleene star is idempotent: $(L^*)^* = L^*$.›

corollary star_star_is_star:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "L {is a language with alphabet} Σ"
  shows "((L*⇧Σ)*⇧Σ) = (L*⇧Σ)"
proof
  from assms have II:"(L*⇧Σ) {is a language with alphabet} Σ" using L_star_lang by auto
  from assms(1) II show "(L*⇧Σ) ⊆ ((L*⇧Σ)*⇧Σ)" using L_in_L_star by auto
  have I:"(L*⇧Σ) ⊆ (L*⇧Σ)" by auto
  from assms have III:"0∈ (L*⇧Σ)" using empty_star by auto
  from assms have IV:"concat((L*⇧Σ),(L*⇧Σ)) ⊆ (L*⇧Σ)" using concat_star by auto
  from I II III IV assms(1) show "((L*⇧Σ)*⇧Σ) ⊆ (L*⇧Σ)" using star_minimal by auto
qed
   

subsection‹The automaton start-eNFSA›

text‹Given a DFSA $(S,s_0,t,F)$ we build an $\epsilon$-NFSA that adds a new initial state
  (the set $S$ itself, as $succ(S) = S\cup\{S\}$) and $\epsilon$-transitions that restart the
  computation from $s_0$. The goal is to show that it recognizes the Kleene star of the
  language of the DFSA.›

text‹The state set of start-eNFSA consists of the states of the DFSA and one new state, $S$.›

definition start_eNFSA_states where
  "start_eNFSA_states(S) ≡ succ(S)"

text‹The transition function of start-eNFSA keeps the transitions of the DFSA, adds
  $\epsilon$-transitions (reading the extra symbol $\Sigma$) from the new state $S$ and from
  each accepting state to $s_0$, and makes all other $\epsilon$-transitions empty.›

definition start_eNFSA_trans where
  "Finite(Σ) ⟹
   (S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ ⟹
   start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ) ≡
     {⟨⟨s,σ⟩,{t`⟨s,σ⟩}⟩. ⟨s,σ⟩∈S×Σ} 
∪ {⟨⟨S,Σ⟩, {s0}⟩} 
   ∪ {⟨⟨f,Σ⟩, {s0}⟩. f∈F} 
∪ {⟨⟨f,Σ⟩, 0⟩. f∈S-F} 
   ∪ {⟨⟨S,q⟩, 0⟩. q∈Σ}"

text‹If $(S,s_0,t,F)$ is a DFSA then start-eNFSA, with accepting states $F\cup\{S\}$,
  is an $\epsilon$-NFSA.›

lemma start_eNFSA_valid:
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)"
  and A:"(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  shows "(start_eNFSA_states(S), S,
  start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), F∪{S}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
proof-
have Sfin:"Finite(S)"
    and s0S:"s0∈S"
    and FS:"F⊆S"
    and t:"t:S×Σ → S"
    using A unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  let ?SS = "start_eNFSA_states(S)"
  let ?tc = "start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)"
  have finSuccS:"Finite(start_eNFSA_states(S))" using Finite_cons Sfin
    unfolding succ_def start_eNFSA_states_def by auto
  have s0SS:"S∈?SS" unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def by auto
  have FSS:"F ⊆ ?SS" unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def using FS by auto
  have tc_type:"?tc : ?SS×succ(Σ) → Pow(?SS)"
  proof-
    have ran:"?tc ∈ Pow((?SS×succ(Σ))×Pow(?SS))"
    proof-
      {
        fix m assume mt:"m∈?tc"
        then obtain x y where tt:"⟨x,y⟩ = m" using t unfolding Pi_def start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A] by auto
        with mt have xy:"⟨x,y⟩∈?tc" by auto
        have xy_dom:"x∈?SS×succ(Σ)"
          using xy t FSS unfolding start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A]
                             start_eNFSA_states_def Pi_def 
          by auto
        have xy_img:"y⊆?SS"
        proof-
          from xy consider
            (a) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S×Σ ∧ x=⟨s,aa⟩ ∧ y={t`⟨s,aa⟩}" |
            (b) "∃s. s∈F ∧ x=⟨s,Σ⟩ ∧ y={s0}" |
            (c) "x=⟨S,Σ⟩ ∧ y={s0}" |
            (d) "∃s. s∈S-F ∧ x=⟨s,Σ⟩ ∧ y=0" |
            (e) "∃s. s∈Σ ∧ x=⟨S,s⟩ ∧ y=0"
            unfolding start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A] by auto
          then show "y⊆?SS"
          proof cases
            case a
            then obtain s aa where sa:"⟨s,aa⟩∈S×Σ" "y={t`⟨s,aa⟩}" by auto
            from sa(1) have "t`⟨s,aa⟩∈S" using apply_type[OF t] by auto
            with sa(2) show ?thesis unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def by auto
          next
            case b
            then obtain s where sb:"s∈F" "y={s0}" by auto
            then show ?thesis using s0S unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def by auto
          next
            case c
            then have sa:"y={s0}" by auto
            then show ?thesis using s0S unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def by auto
          next
            case d
            then have sa:"y=0" by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
          next
            case e
            then have "y=0" by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
          qed
        qed
        from xy_dom xy_img have "⟨x,y⟩∈(?SS×succ(Σ))×Pow(?SS)" by auto
        with tt have "m∈(?SS×succ(Σ))×Pow(?SS)" by auto
      }
      then show ?thesis by auto
    qed
    moreover have "function(?tc)"
    proof -
      {
        fix x y z
        assume h1:"⟨x,y⟩∈?tc" and h2:"⟨x,z⟩∈?tc"
        from h1 consider
            (a1) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S×Σ ∧ x=⟨s,aa⟩ ∧ y={t`⟨s,aa⟩}" |
            (b1) "∃s. s∈F ∧ x=⟨s,Σ⟩ ∧ y={s0}" |
            (c1) "x=⟨S,Σ⟩ ∧ y={s0}" |
            (d1) "∃s. s∈S-F ∧ x=⟨s,Σ⟩ ∧ y=0" |
            (e1) "∃s. s∈Σ ∧ x=⟨S,s⟩ ∧ y=0"
          unfolding start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A] by auto
        then have "y=z"
        proof cases
          case a1
          then obtain s aa where sa:"⟨s,aa⟩∈S×Σ" "x=⟨s,aa⟩" "y={t`⟨s,aa⟩}" by auto
          from h2 consider
            (a2) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S×Σ ∧ x=⟨s,aa⟩ ∧ z={t`⟨s,aa⟩}" |
            (b2) "∃s. s∈F ∧ x=⟨s,Σ⟩ ∧ z={s0}" |
            (c2) "x=⟨S,Σ⟩ ∧ z={s0}" |
            (d2) "∃s. s∈S-F ∧ x=⟨s,Σ⟩ ∧ z=0" |
            (e2) "∃s. s∈Σ ∧ x=⟨S,s⟩ ∧ z=0"
          unfolding start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A] by auto
          then show ?thesis
          proof cases
            case a2
            then obtain p q where pq:"⟨p,q⟩∈S×Σ" "x=⟨p,q⟩" "z={t`⟨p,q⟩}" by auto
            from pq(2) sa(2) have "p=s" "q=aa" by auto
            with sa(3) pq(3) show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case b2
            then obtain p where pq:"p∈F" "x=⟨p,Σ⟩" "z={s0}" by auto
            from pq(2) sa(1,2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case c2
            then have pq:"x=⟨S,Σ⟩" "z={s0}" by auto
            from pq(1) sa(1,2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case d2
            then obtain p where pq:"p∈S-F" "x=⟨p,Σ⟩" "z=0" by auto
            from pq(1,2) sa(1,2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
          next
            case e2
            then obtain s where "s∈Σ" "x=⟨S,s⟩" by auto
            with sa(1,2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
          qed
        next
          case b1
          then obtain s where sa:"s∈F" "x=⟨s,Σ⟩" "y={s0}" by auto
          from h2 consider
            (a2) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S×Σ ∧ x=⟨s,aa⟩ ∧ z={t`⟨s,aa⟩}" |
            (b2) "∃s. s∈F ∧ x=⟨s,Σ⟩ ∧ z={s0}" |
            (c2) "x=⟨S,Σ⟩ ∧ z={s0}" |
            (d2) "∃s. s∈S-F ∧ x=⟨s,Σ⟩ ∧ z=0" |
            (e2) "∃s. s∈Σ ∧ x=⟨S,s⟩ ∧ z=0"
          unfolding start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A] by auto
          then show ?thesis
          proof cases
            case a2
            then obtain p q where pq:"⟨p,q⟩∈S×Σ" "x=⟨p,q⟩" "z={t`⟨p,q⟩}" by auto
            from pq(1,2) sa(2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case b2
            then obtain p where pq:"p∈F" "x=⟨p,Σ⟩" "z={s0}" by auto
            from pq(2) sa(1,2) have "p=s" by auto
            with sa(3) pq(3) show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case c2
            then have pq:"x=⟨S,Σ⟩" "z={s0}" by auto
            from FS sa(1) have "s∈S" by auto
            with pq(1) sa(2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case d2
            then obtain p where pq:"p∈S-F" "x=⟨p,Σ⟩" "z=0" by auto
            from pq(1,2) sa(1,2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case e2
            then obtain p where pq:"p∈Σ" "x=⟨S,p⟩" "z=0" by auto
            from pq(1,2) sa(1,2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
          qed
        next
          case c1
          then have sa: "x=⟨S,Σ⟩" "y={s0}" by auto
          from h2 consider
            (a2) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S×Σ ∧ x=⟨s,aa⟩ ∧ z={t`⟨s,aa⟩}" |
            (b2) "∃s. s∈F ∧ x=⟨s,Σ⟩ ∧ z={s0}" |
            (c2) "x=⟨S,Σ⟩ ∧ z={s0}" |
            (d2) "∃s. s∈S-F ∧ x=⟨s,Σ⟩ ∧ z=0" |
            (e2) "∃s. s∈Σ ∧ x=⟨S,s⟩ ∧ z=0"
          unfolding start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A] by auto
          then show ?thesis
          proof cases
            case a2
            then obtain p q where pq:"⟨p,q⟩∈S×Σ" "x=⟨p,q⟩" "z={t`⟨p,q⟩}" by auto
            from pq(1,2) sa(1) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case b2
            then obtain p where pq:"p∈F" "x=⟨p,Σ⟩" "z={s0}" by auto
            from pq(1) FS have "p:S" by auto
            with pq(2) sa(1) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case c2
            then have pq:"x=⟨S,Σ⟩" "z={s0}" by auto
            with sa show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case d2
            then obtain p where pq:"p∈S-F" "x=⟨p,Σ⟩" "z=0" by auto
            from pq(1,2) sa(1,2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case e2
            then obtain p where pq:"p∈Σ" "x=⟨S,p⟩" "z=0" by auto
            from pq(1,2) sa(1,2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
          qed
        next
          case d1
          then obtain p where sa: "x=⟨p,Σ⟩" "y=0" "p∈S-F" by auto
          from h2 consider
            (a2) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S×Σ ∧ x=⟨s,aa⟩ ∧ z={t`⟨s,aa⟩}" |
            (b2) "∃s. s∈F ∧ x=⟨s,Σ⟩ ∧ z={s0}" |
            (c2) "x=⟨S,Σ⟩ ∧ z={s0}" |
            (d2) "∃s. s∈S-F ∧ x=⟨s,Σ⟩ ∧ z=0" |
            (e2) "∃s. s∈Σ ∧ x=⟨S,s⟩ ∧ z=0"
          unfolding start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A] by auto
          then show ?thesis
          proof cases
            case a2
            then obtain p q where pq:"⟨p,q⟩∈S×Σ" "x=⟨p,q⟩" "z={t`⟨p,q⟩}" by auto
            from pq(1,2) sa(1) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case b2
            then obtain q where pq:"q∈F" "x=⟨q,Σ⟩" "z={s0}" by auto
            from pq(1,2) sa(1,3) have False by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case c2
            then have pq:"x=⟨S,Σ⟩" "z={s0}" by auto
            from sa(1) pq(1) have "p=S" by auto
            with sa(3) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            with sa show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case d2
            then obtain q where pq:"q∈S-F" "x=⟨q,Σ⟩" "z=0" by auto
            from sa(2) pq(3) show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case e2
            then obtain p where pq:"p∈Σ" "x=⟨S,p⟩" "z=0" by auto
            from pq(1,2) sa(1,2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
          qed
        next
          case e1
          then obtain p where sa:"p:Σ" "x=⟨S,p⟩" "y=0" by auto
          from h2 consider
            (a2) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S×Σ ∧ x=⟨s,aa⟩ ∧ z={t`⟨s,aa⟩}" |
            (b2) "∃s. s∈F ∧ x=⟨s,Σ⟩ ∧ z={s0}" |
            (c2) "x=⟨S,Σ⟩ ∧ z={s0}" |
            (d2) "∃s. s∈S-F ∧ x=⟨s,Σ⟩ ∧ z=0" |
            (e2) "∃s. s∈Σ ∧ x=⟨S,s⟩ ∧ z=0"
          unfolding start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A] by auto
          then show ?thesis
          proof cases
            case a2
            then obtain p q where pq:"⟨p,q⟩∈S×Σ" "x=⟨p,q⟩" "z={t`⟨p,q⟩}" by auto
            from pq(1,2) sa(2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case b2
            then obtain q where pq:"q∈F" "x=⟨q,Σ⟩" "z={s0}" by auto
            from pq(1,2) sa(1,2) have False  using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case c2
            then have pq:"x=⟨S,Σ⟩" "z={s0}" by auto
            with sa(1,2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            with sa show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case d2
            then obtain q where pq:"q∈S-F" "x=⟨q,Σ⟩" "z=0" by auto
            from sa(3) pq(3) show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case e2
            then obtain p where pq:"p∈Σ" "x=⟨S,p⟩" "z=0" by auto
            from sa(3) pq(3) show ?thesis by auto
          qed
        qed
      }
      then show ?thesis unfolding function_def by auto
    qed
    moreover have "?SS×succ(Σ) ⊆ domain(?tc)"
    proof
      fix x assume hx:"x∈?SS×succ(Σ)"
      then obtain p aa where pa:"p∈?SS" "aa∈succ(Σ)" "x=⟨p,aa⟩" by auto
      from pa(1) have ps:"p:S∨ p=S"
        unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def by auto
      from pa(2) have acase:"aa∈Σ ∨ aa=Σ" using succ_iff by auto
      from ps show "x∈domain(?tc)"
      proof (elim disjE conjE)
        assume hs1:"p∈S"
        from acase show ?thesis
        proof (elim disjE)
          assume "aa∈Σ"
          with hs1 pa(3) have "⟨x,{t`⟨p,aa⟩}⟩∈?tc"
            unfolding start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A] by auto
          then show ?thesis unfolding domain_def by auto
        next
          assume as:"aa=Σ"
          {
            assume "p∈F"
            with pa(3) as have "⟨x,{s0}⟩∈?tc"
              unfolding start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A] by auto
            then have ?thesis unfolding domain_def by auto
          } moreover
          {
            assume "p∉F"
            with hs1 have "p∈S-F" by auto
            with pa(3) as have "⟨x,0⟩∈?tc"
              unfolding start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A] by auto
            then have ?thesis unfolding domain_def by auto
          } ultimately
          show ?thesis by auto
        qed
      next
        assume hs2:"p=S"
        from acase show ?thesis
        proof (elim disjE)
          assume "aa∈Σ"
          with hs2 pa(3) have "⟨x,0⟩∈?tc"
            unfolding start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A] by auto
          then show ?thesis unfolding domain_def by auto
        next
          assume "aa=Σ"
          with hs2 pa(3) have "⟨x,{s0}⟩∈?tc"
            unfolding start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A] by auto
          then show ?thesis unfolding domain_def by auto
        qed
      qed
    qed
    ultimately show ?thesis unfolding Pi_def by auto
  qed
  show ?thesis unfolding FullNFSA_def[OF fin]
    using tc_type finSuccS FSS s0SS by auto 
qed

subsection‹Computing epsilon-closure for start-eNFSA›

text‹In this section we compute the $\epsilon$-transitions of start-eNFSA and the
  $\epsilon$-closures of the sets of states we need.›

text‹The $\epsilon$-transition from the new state $S$ leads to $\{s_0\}$.›

lemma epsilon_trans_fun_S:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  shows "start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)`⟨S,Σ⟩ = {s0}"
proof-
  from assms have "(start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans
               (S, s0, t, F, Σ),F∪{S}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ" using start_eNFSA_valid
    by auto
  then have f:"start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ):succ(S)×succ(Σ)→Pow(succ(S))"
    using FullNFSA_def[OF assms(1)] unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def by auto
  have "⟨⟨S,Σ⟩,{s0}⟩∈start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ)"
    using start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF assms] by auto
  with f show ?thesis using apply_equality by auto
qed

text‹The $\epsilon$-transition from an accepting state $u\in F$ leads to $\{s_0\}$.
  This is the restart that allows concatenating words.›

lemma epsilon_trans_fun_F:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ" and "u∈F"
  shows "start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)`⟨u,Σ⟩ = {s0}"
proof-
  from assms have "(start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans
               (S, s0, t, F, Σ),F∪{S}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ" using start_eNFSA_valid
    by auto
  then have f:"start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ):succ(S)×succ(Σ)→Pow(succ(S))"
    using FullNFSA_def[OF assms(1)] unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def by auto
  have "⟨⟨u,Σ⟩,{s0}⟩∈start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ)"
    using start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF assms(1,2)] assms(3) by auto
  with f show ?thesis using apply_equality by auto
qed


text‹A non-accepting state $u\in S\setminus F$ has no $\epsilon$-transitions.›

lemma epsilon_trans_fun_s:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ" and "u∈S-F"
  shows "start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)`⟨u,Σ⟩ = 0"
proof-
  from assms have "(start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans
               (S, s0, t, F, Σ),F∪{S}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ" using start_eNFSA_valid
    by auto
  then have f:"start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ):succ(S)×succ(Σ)→Pow(succ(S))"
    using FullNFSA_def[OF assms(1)] unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def by auto
  have "⟨⟨u,Σ⟩,0⟩∈start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ)"
    using start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF assms(1,2)] assms(3) by auto
  with f show ?thesis using apply_equality by auto
qed

text‹Using the general epsilon-closure lemmas, we compute what epsilon-closure
looks like for the specific state sets in start-eNFSA.›

lemma epsilon_cl_F_in_cl_S:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  shows "ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S), start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), Σ, {S}) = {S,s0}"
proof
  let ?r = "{⟨Q,{s∈succ(S). ∃q∈Q. s ∈ start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)`⟨q,Σ⟩}⟩. Q∈Pow(succ(S))}"
  {
    fix y assume y:"y∈{S,s0}"
    let ?B="{s∈succ(S). ∃m∈{S}. s∈start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ)`⟨m,Σ⟩}"
    {
      assume "y=S"
      then have "y∈ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S), start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), Σ, {S})"
        using epsilon_cl_refl_sub[OF assms(1) start_eNFSA_valid[OF assms]]
        unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def by auto
    } moreover
    {
      assume "y≠S"
      with y have "y∈{s0}" by auto moreover
      from this have "y∈S" using assms(2) DFSA_def[OF assms(1)] by auto
      then have "y∈succ(S)" by auto
      moreover
      have "?B = succ(S)∩({s0})"
        using epsilon_trans_fun_S[OF assms] by auto
      ultimately have y:"y∈?B" by auto
      have "⟨{S},{s∈succ(S). ∃m∈{S}. s∈start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ)`⟨m,Σ⟩}⟩∈?r"  by auto
      then have "⟨{S},{s∈succ(S). ∃m∈{S}. s∈start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ)`⟨m,Σ⟩}⟩∈?r^*" 
        using r_into_rtrancl by auto
      moreover have "{S} ⊆ succ(S)" by auto
      ultimately have "{s∈succ(S). ∃m∈{S}. s∈start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ)`⟨m,Σ⟩} ⊆ ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S), start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), Σ, {S})"
        using EpsilonClosure_def[OF assms(1) start_eNFSA_valid[OF assms], of "{S}"]
        unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def by force
      with y have "y∈ ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S), start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), Σ, {S})"
        by auto
    } ultimately
    have "y∈ ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S), start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), Σ, {S})"
      by auto
  }
  then show "{S,s0} ⊆ ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S), start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), Σ, {S})"
    by auto
  {
    fix y assume "y∈ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S), start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), Σ, {S})"
    then obtain P where P:"P∈Pow(succ(S))" "y∈P" "⟨{S},P⟩∈({⟨Q,{s∈succ(S). ∃q∈Q. 
      s ∈ start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ)`⟨q,Σ⟩}⟩. Q∈Pow(succ(S))}^*)"
      using EpsilonClosure_def[OF assms(1) start_eNFSA_valid[OF assms], of "{S}"]
      unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def by auto
    let ?r = "{⟨Q,{s∈succ(S). ∃q∈Q. s ∈ start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ)`⟨q,Σ⟩}⟩. Q∈Pow(succ(S))}"
    {
      assume "⟨{S},P⟩∈id(field(?r))"
      then have "P={S}" by auto
      with P(2) have "y:{S}" by auto
      then have "y = S" by auto
      then have "y∈{S,s0}" by auto
    } moreover
    {
      assume "⟨{S},P⟩∉id(field(?r))"
      moreover from P(3) have "⟨{S},P⟩∈id(field(?r))∪(?r O ?r^*)" using rtrancl_unfold by auto
      ultimately have "⟨{S},P⟩∈(?r O ?r^*)" by auto
      then obtain Q where q:"⟨{S},Q⟩∈?r^*" "⟨Q,P⟩∈?r" using compE by auto
      from q(2) have p:"P={s∈succ(S). ∃u∈Q. s∈start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)`⟨u,Σ⟩}" "Q∈Pow(succ(S))" by auto
      from P(2) p(1) obtain u where u:"u∈Q" "y∈start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)`⟨u,Σ⟩" by auto
      {
        assume "u=S"
        then have "start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)`⟨u,Σ⟩ = {s0}"
          using epsilon_trans_fun_S[OF assms] by auto
        with u(2) have "y∈{s0}" by auto
        then have "y∈{S,s0}" by auto
      }
      moreover
      {
        assume "u≠S"
        with u(1) p(2) have uS:"u∈S" by auto
        {
          assume "u∈F"
          then have "start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)`⟨u,Σ⟩ = {s0}"
            using epsilon_trans_fun_F[OF assms] by auto
          with u(2) have "y=s0" by auto
          then have "y∈ {S,s0}" by auto
        } moreover
        {
          assume "u∉F"
          then have "start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)`⟨u,Σ⟩ = 0"
            using epsilon_trans_fun_s[OF assms] uS by auto
          with u(2) have "False" by auto
          then have "y∈ {S,s0}" by auto
        } ultimately
        have "y∈ {S,s0}" by auto
      }
      ultimately have "y∈ {S,s0}" by auto
    }
    ultimately have "y∈ {S,s0}" by auto
  }
  then show " ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S), start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ), Σ, {S}) ⊆
   {S,s0}" by auto
qed

text‹The $\epsilon$-closure of a non-accepting state $q\in S\setminus F$ is just $\{q\}$.›

lemma epsilon_cl_s0_result:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ" "q∈S-F"
  shows "ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S), start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), Σ, {q}) = {q}"
proof
  from assms(2) have s:"s0∈S" using DFSA_def[OF assms(1)] by auto
  have valid:"(start_eNFSA_states(S), S, start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), F∪{S}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    using start_eNFSA_valid[OF assms(1,2)] by auto
  from s have A:"{q} ⊆ start_eNFSA_states(S)" unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def using assms(3) by auto
  from epsilon_cl_refl_sub[OF assms(1) valid] `{q} ⊆ start_eNFSA_states(S)`
  show "{q} ⊆ ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S), start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), Σ, {q})" by auto
  {
    fix y assume y:"y∈ ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S), start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), Σ, {q})"
    from A y obtain P where P:"P∈Pow(succ(S))" "y∈P" "⟨{q},P⟩∈({⟨Q,{s∈succ(S). ∃q∈Q.
      s ∈ start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ)`⟨q,Σ⟩}⟩. Q∈Pow(succ(S))}^*)"
      using EpsilonClosure_def[OF assms(1) start_eNFSA_valid[OF assms(1,2)], of "{q}"]
      unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def by auto
    let ?r = "{⟨Q,{s∈succ(S). ∃q∈Q. s ∈ start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ)`⟨q,Σ⟩}⟩. Q∈Pow(succ(S))}"
    {
      assume "⟨{q},P⟩∈id(field(?r))"
      then have "P={q}" by auto
      with P(2) have "y:{q}" by auto
      then have "y = q" by auto
      then have "y∈{q}" by auto
    } moreover
    {
      assume "⟨{q},P⟩∉id(field(?r))"
      moreover from P(3) have "⟨{q},P⟩∈id(field(?r))∪(?r O ?r^*)" using rtrancl_unfold by auto
      ultimately have "⟨{q},P⟩∈(?r O ?r^*)" by auto
      then obtain Q where q:"⟨{q},Q⟩∈?r^*" "⟨Q,P⟩∈?r" using compE by auto
      {
        fix x z assume as:"⟨{q},x⟩∈?r^*"
          "⟨x,z⟩∈?r" "x⊆{q}"
        {
          assume "x≠0"
          with as(3) have xq:"x={q}" by auto
          from as(2) have "z={s ∈ succ(S) .
          ∃q∈x. s ∈ start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ) ` ⟨q, Σ⟩}" by auto
          with xq have "z={s ∈ succ(S) .
          ∃q∈{q}. s ∈ start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ) ` ⟨q, Σ⟩}" by auto
          then have "z=succ(S)∩(start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ) ` ⟨q, Σ⟩)" by auto
          then have "z=succ(S)∩0" using epsilon_trans_fun_s[OF assms] by auto
          then have "z⊆{q}" by auto
        } moreover
        {
          assume "x=0"
          with as(2) have "z=0" by auto
          then have "z⊆{q}" by auto
        }
        ultimately have "z⊆{q}" by auto
      }  
      with rtrancl_induct[OF P(3), where P="λt. t⊆{q}"]
      have "P⊆{q}" by auto
      with P(2) have "y=q" by auto
    } ultimately have "y∈{q}" by auto
  }
  then show " ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S), start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), Σ, {q})⊆{q}" by auto
qed

subsection‹start-eNFSA recognizes the Kleene star›

text‹We show that the language accepted by start-eNFSA contains $L$ and the empty word,
  which are the first ingredients needed to apply minimality of the Kleene star.›

text‹The set of words accepted by start-eNFSA is a language over $\Sigma$,
  as it is a subset of the set of all words over $\Sigma$.›

lemma eNFSA_lang_is_language:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  shows "{w ∈ Lists(Σ). w <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S), S,
  start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), F){in alphabet}Σ}
         {is a language with alphabet}Σ"
proof-
  have "{w ∈ Lists(Σ). w <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S), S,
  start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), F){in alphabet}Σ} ⊆ Lists(Σ)"
    by (auto simp: Collect_subset)
  thus "{w ∈ Lists(Σ). w <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S), S,
  start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), F){in alphabet}Σ}
        {is a language with alphabet}Σ"
    using assms(1) IsALanguage_def by simp
qed

text‹The empty word is accepted by start-eNFSA, because the $\epsilon$-closure of the
  initial state $S$ contains $S$, which is an accepting state.›

lemma empty_in_eNFSA_lang:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  shows "0∈ {w ∈ Lists(Σ). w <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S), S,
                                start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ}"
proof
  show ol:"0∈Lists(Σ)" unfolding Lists_def Pi_def function_def by auto
  have "s0∈S" using assms(2) DFSA_def[OF assms(1)] by auto
  then have "ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S),start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),Σ,{S}) = {S,s0}"
    using epsilon_cl_F_in_cl_S assms by auto
  then show "0 <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ),F ∪ {S}){in alphabet}Σ"
    using FullNFSASatisfy_def[OF assms(1)] start_eNFSA_valid[OF assms] ol by auto
qed


text‹On a symbol of the alphabet, the transition function of start-eNFSA from a state of the DFSA
  agrees with the transition function of the DFSA.›

lemma start_eNFSA_trans_symbol:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ" "u∈S" "σ∈Σ"
  shows "start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)`⟨u,σ⟩ = {t`⟨u,σ⟩}"
proof-
  from assms(1,2) have "(start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans
               (S, s0, t, F, Σ),F∪{S}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ" using start_eNFSA_valid
    by auto
  then have f:"start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ):succ(S)×succ(Σ)→Pow(succ(S))"
    using FullNFSA_def[OF assms(1)] unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def by auto
  have "⟨⟨u,σ⟩,{t`⟨u,σ⟩}⟩∈start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ)"
    using start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF assms(1,2)] assms(3,4) by auto
  with f show ?thesis using apply_equality by auto
qed

text‹On symbols of the alphabet there are no transitions from the new state $S$.›

lemma start_eNFSA_trans_symbol_S:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ" "σ∈Σ"
  shows "start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)`⟨S,σ⟩ = 0"
proof-
  from assms(1,2) have "(start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans
               (S,s0,t,F,Σ),F∪{S}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ" using start_eNFSA_valid
    by auto
  then have f:"start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ):succ(S)×succ(Σ)→Pow(succ(S))"
    using FullNFSA_def[OF assms(1)] unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def by auto
  have "⟨⟨S,σ⟩,0⟩∈start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)"
    using start_eNFSA_trans_def[OF assms(1,2)] assms(3) by auto
  with f show ?thesis using apply_equality by auto
qed

text‹On a symbol of the alphabet, start-eNFSA moves every state only to states of the DFSA.›

lemma start_eNFSA_trans_symbol_sub:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ" "u∈succ(S)" "σ∈Σ"
  shows "start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)`⟨u,σ⟩ ⊆ S"
proof-
  from assms(1,2) have tT:"t:S×Σ→S" using DFSA_def[OF assms(1)] by auto
  from assms(3) have "u=S ∨ u∈S" by auto
  then show ?thesis
  proof
    assume "u=S"
    then show ?thesis using start_eNFSA_trans_symbol_S assms(1,2,4) by auto
  next
    assume uS:"u∈S"
    then have "start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)`⟨u,σ⟩ = {t`⟨u,σ⟩}"
      using start_eNFSA_trans_symbol assms(1,2,4) by auto
    moreover from tT uS assms(4) have "t`⟨u,σ⟩∈S" using apply_type by auto
    ultimately show ?thesis by auto
  qed
qed

text‹The $\epsilon$-closure of a set of states of start-eNFSA is a set of states of start-eNFSA.›

lemma start_eNFSA_cl_subset:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ" "E⊆start_eNFSA_states(S)"
  shows "ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S),start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),Σ,E) ⊆ start_eNFSA_states(S)"
proof-
  have valid:"(start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),F∪{S}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    using start_eNFSA_valid[OF assms(1,2)] by auto
  show ?thesis using EpsilonClosure_def[OF assms(1) valid assms(3)] by auto
qed

text‹If $U$ is a set of states of the DFSA, then the $\epsilon$-closure of $U$ in start-eNFSA
  consists of the elements of $U$ and possibly of $s_0$, which is added only when $U$
  contains an accepting state of the DFSA.›

lemma start_eNFSA_cl_upper:
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)" and A:"(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and US:"U⊆S"
  and x:"x∈ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S),start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),Σ,U)"
  shows "x∈U ∨ (x=s0 ∧ U∩F≠0)"
proof-
  let ?SS = "start_eNFSA_states(S)"
  let ?tc = "start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)"
  have valid:"(?SS,S,?tc,F∪{S}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    using start_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A] by auto
  from A have s0S:"s0∈S" using DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have USS:"U⊆?SS" using US unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def by auto
  let ?r = "{⟨Q,{s∈?SS. ∃q∈Q. s∈?tc`⟨q,Σ⟩}⟩. Q∈Pow(?SS)}"
  from x obtain P where P:"P∈Pow(?SS)" "x∈P" "⟨U,P⟩∈?r^*"
    using EpsilonClosure_def[OF fin valid USS] by auto
  have inv:"P⊆U∪{s0} ∧ (s0∈P ⟶ s0∈U ∨ U∩F≠0)"
  proof(rule rtrancl_induct[OF P(3), where P="λy. y⊆U∪{s0} ∧ (s0∈y ⟶ s0∈U ∨ U∩F≠0)"])
    show "U⊆U∪{s0} ∧ (s0∈U ⟶ s0∈U ∨ U∩F≠0)" by auto
  next
    fix y z assume as:"⟨U,y⟩∈?r^*" "⟨y,z⟩∈?r"
      "y⊆U∪{s0} ∧ (s0∈y ⟶ s0∈U ∨ U∩F≠0)"
    from as(2) have zdef:"z={s∈?SS. ∃q∈y. s∈?tc`⟨q,Σ⟩}" by auto
    have key:"∀e∈z. e=s0 ∧ (∃q∈y. q∈F)"
    proof(rule ballI)
      fix e assume ez:"e∈z"
      with zdef obtain q where q:"q∈y" "e∈?tc`⟨q,Σ⟩" by auto
      from q(1) as(3) have "q∈U ∨ q=s0" by auto
      with US s0S have qS:"q∈S" by auto
      show "e=s0 ∧ (∃q∈y. q∈F)"
      proof(cases "q∈F")
        case True
        then have "?tc`⟨q,Σ⟩ = {s0}" using epsilon_trans_fun_F[OF fin A True] by auto
        with q True show ?thesis by auto
      next
        case False
        with qS have qSF:"q∈S-F" by auto
        then have "?tc`⟨q,Σ⟩ = 0" using epsilon_trans_fun_s[OF fin A qSF] by auto
        with q(2) show ?thesis by auto
      qed
    qed
    then have "z⊆U∪{s0}" by auto
    moreover
    {
      assume s0z:"s0∈z"
      with key obtain q where q:"q∈y" "q∈F" by auto
      from q(1) as(3) have "q∈U ∨ q=s0" by auto
      then have "s0∈U ∨ U∩F≠0"
      proof
        assume "q∈U"
        with q(2) show ?thesis by auto
      next
        assume "q=s0"
        with q(1) as(3) show ?thesis by auto
      qed
    }
    ultimately show "z⊆U∪{s0} ∧ (s0∈z ⟶ s0∈U ∨ U∩F≠0)" by auto
  qed
  show ?thesis
  proof(cases "x∈U")
    case True
    then show ?thesis by auto
  next
    case False
    with P(2) inv have xs:"x=s0" by auto
    with P(2) inv have "s0∈U ∨ U∩F≠0" by auto
    with False xs show ?thesis by auto
  qed
qed

text‹If the $\epsilon$-closure computed in start-eNFSA from the set $E$ is going to be iterated, we need
  to know that $s_0$ is in the closure whenever $E$ contains an accepting state or the new state $S$.›

lemma start_eNFSA_s0_in_cl:
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)" and A:"(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and E:"E⊆start_eNFSA_states(S)" and e:"e∈E" "e∈F∪{S}"
  shows "s0∈ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S),start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),Σ,E)"
proof-
  let ?SS = "start_eNFSA_states(S)"
  let ?tc = "start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)"
  have valid:"(?SS,S,?tc,F∪{S}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    using start_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A] by auto
  from A have s0S:"s0∈S" using DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have tce:"?tc`⟨e,Σ⟩ = {s0}"
  proof-
    from e(2) have "e∈F ∨ e=S" by auto
    then show ?thesis
    proof
      assume eF:"e∈F"
      then show ?thesis using epsilon_trans_fun_F[OF fin A eF] by auto
    next
      assume "e=S"
      then show ?thesis using epsilon_trans_fun_S[OF fin A] by auto
    qed
  qed
  let ?r = "{⟨Q,{s∈?SS. ∃q∈Q. s∈?tc`⟨q,Σ⟩}⟩. Q∈Pow(?SS)}"
  let ?B = "{s∈?SS. ∃q∈E. s∈?tc`⟨q,Σ⟩}"
  have EP:"E∈Pow(?SS)" using E by auto
  have B:"?B∈Pow(?SS)" by auto
  have "s0∈ start_eNFSA_states(S)" using s0S unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def by auto moreover
  have "s0∈start_eNFSA_trans(S, s0, t, F, Σ) `⟨e, Σ⟩" using tce by auto
  ultimately have s0B:"s0∈?B" using e(1) by auto
  from EP have "⟨E,?B⟩∈?r" by auto
  then have "⟨E,?B⟩∈?r^*" using r_into_rtrancl by auto
  with B have "?B ⊆ ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,E)"
    using EpsilonClosure_def[OF fin valid E] by force
  with s0B show ?thesis by auto
qed

text‹If an execution of an $\epsilon$-NFSA reduces the word $j$ to the word $r$, then the same execution,
  started at the same set of states, reduces $s\cdot j$ to $s\cdot r$ for any word $s$.›

lemma eps_nfsa_run_prefix:
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)" and fsa:"(X,x0,tt,Acc){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and run:"⟨⟨j,P0⟩,⟨r,Q1⟩⟩∈({reduce ε-N-relation}(X,tt){in alphabet}Σ)^*"
  and jNE:"j∈NELists(Σ)" and PX:"P0∈Pow(X)" and sL:"s∈Lists(Σ)"
  shows "⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P0⟩,⟨Concat(s,r),Q1⟩⟩∈({reduce ε-N-relation}(X,tt){in alphabet}Σ)^*"
proof-
  let ?R = "{reduce ε-N-relation}(X,tt){in alphabet}Σ"
  have Csj:"Concat(s,j)∈NELists(Σ)" using concat_is_NElist[OF sL jNE] by auto
  from Csj PX have "⟨Concat(s,j),P0⟩∈field(?R)" using eps_nfsa_field(2)[OF fin fsa] by auto
  then have base:"⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P0⟩,⟨Concat(s,j),P0⟩⟩∈?R^*" using rtrancl_refl by auto
  have "⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P0⟩,⟨Concat(s,fst(⟨r,Q1⟩)),snd(⟨r,Q1⟩)⟩⟩∈?R^*"
  proof(rule rtrancl_induct[OF run, where P="λy. ⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P0⟩,⟨Concat(s,fst(y)),snd(y)⟩⟩∈?R^*"])
    show "⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P0⟩,⟨Concat(s,fst(⟨j,P0⟩)),snd(⟨j,P0⟩)⟩⟩∈?R^*"
      using base by auto
  next
    fix y z assume as:"⟨⟨j,P0⟩,y⟩∈?R^*" "⟨y,z⟩∈?R"
      "⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P0⟩,⟨Concat(s,fst(y)),snd(y)⟩⟩∈?R^*"
    from as(2) obtain yl Qy where yz:"yl∈NELists(Σ)" "Qy∈Pow(X)" "y=⟨yl,Qy⟩"
      "z=⟨Init(yl),ε-cl(X,tt,Σ,⋃{tt`⟨u,Last(yl)⟩. u∈ε-cl(X,tt,Σ,Qy)})⟩"
      unfolding FullNFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin fsa] by auto
    have Csyl:"Concat(s,yl)∈NELists(Σ)" using concat_is_NElist[OF sL yz(1)] by auto
    have lastEq:"Last(Concat(s,yl)) = Last(yl)" using concat_last_NElist[OF sL yz(1)] by auto
    have initEq:"Init(Concat(s,yl)) = Concat(s,Init(yl))" using concat_init_NElist[OF sL yz(1)] by auto
    from as(3) yz(3) have A1:"⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P0⟩,⟨Concat(s,yl),Qy⟩⟩∈?R^*" by auto
    have "⟨⟨Concat(s,yl),Qy⟩,⟨Init(Concat(s,yl)),ε-cl(X,tt,Σ,⋃{tt`⟨u,Last(Concat(s,yl))⟩. u∈ε-cl(X,tt,Σ,Qy)})⟩⟩∈?R"
      unfolding FullNFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin fsa] using Csyl yz(2) by auto
    with lastEq initEq have step:"⟨⟨Concat(s,yl),Qy⟩,⟨Concat(s,Init(yl)),ε-cl(X,tt,Σ,⋃{tt`⟨u,Last(yl)⟩. u∈ε-cl(X,tt,Σ,Qy)})⟩⟩∈?R"
      by auto
    with A1 have "⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P0⟩,⟨Concat(s,Init(yl)),ε-cl(X,tt,Σ,⋃{tt`⟨u,Last(yl)⟩. u∈ε-cl(X,tt,Σ,Qy)})⟩⟩∈?R^*"
      using rtrancl_into_rtrancl by auto
    with yz(4) show "⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P0⟩,⟨Concat(s,fst(z)),snd(z)⟩⟩∈?R^*" by auto
  qed
  then show ?thesis by auto
qed

text‹Every execution of the DFSA on a nonempty word, starting at $s_0$, is simulated by
  an execution of start-eNFSA that starts at any set $P_0$ of states whose $\epsilon$-closure contains
  $s_0$: if the DFSA reaches the state $q$ then $q$ belongs to the $\epsilon$-closure of the set of
  states reached by start-eNFSA.›

lemma start_eNFSA_simulates_DFSA_from:
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)" and A:"(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and run:"⟨⟨w,s0⟩,⟨r,q⟩⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ)^*"
  and wne:"w∈NELists(Σ)"
  and P0:"P0∈Pow(start_eNFSA_states(S))"
  and s0P:"s0∈ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S),start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),Σ,P0)"
  shows "∃Q∈Pow(start_eNFSA_states(S)). q∈ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S),start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),Σ,Q) ∧
    ⟨⟨w,P0⟩,⟨r,Q⟩⟩∈({reduce ε-N-relation}(start_eNFSA_states(S),start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)){in alphabet}Σ)^*"
proof-
  let ?SS = "start_eNFSA_states(S)"
  let ?tc = "start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)"
  let ?r = "{reduce ε-N-relation}(?SS,?tc){in alphabet}Σ"
  have valid:"(?SS,S,?tc,F∪{S}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    using start_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A] by auto
  have tT:"?tc:?SS×succ(Σ)→Pow(?SS)" using valid unfolding FullNFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have cl_sub:"⋀E. E⊆?SS ⟹ ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,E) ⊆ ?SS"
  proof-
    fix E assume E:"E⊆?SS"
    show "ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,E) ⊆ ?SS" using start_eNFSA_cl_subset[OF fin A E] by auto
  qed
  have key:"∃Q∈Pow(?SS). snd(⟨r,q⟩)∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q) ∧ ⟨⟨w,P0⟩,⟨fst(⟨r,q⟩),Q⟩⟩∈?r^*"
  proof(rule rtrancl_induct[OF run, where P="λy. ∃Q∈Pow(?SS). snd(y)∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q) ∧ ⟨⟨w,P0⟩,⟨fst(y),Q⟩⟩∈?r^*"])
    from wne P0 have "⟨w,P0⟩∈field(?r)" using eps_nfsa_field(2)[OF fin valid] by auto
    then have "⟨⟨w,P0⟩,⟨w,P0⟩⟩∈?r^*" using rtrancl_refl by auto
    with s0P P0 show "∃Q∈Pow(?SS). snd(⟨w,s0⟩)∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q) ∧ ⟨⟨w,P0⟩,⟨fst(⟨w,s0⟩),Q⟩⟩∈?r^*"
      by auto
  next
    fix y z assume as:"⟨⟨w,s0⟩,y⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ)^*"
      "⟨y,z⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ)"
      "∃Q∈Pow(?SS). snd(y)∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q) ∧ ⟨⟨w,P0⟩,⟨fst(y),Q⟩⟩∈?r^*"
    from as(2) obtain yl ys where yz:"yl∈NELists(Σ)" "ys∈S" "y=⟨yl,ys⟩" "z=⟨Init(yl),t`⟨ys,Last(yl)⟩⟩"
      unfolding DFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin A] by auto
    from yz(3) as(3) obtain Qy where Q:"Qy∈Pow(?SS)" "ys∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Qy)" "⟨⟨w,P0⟩,⟨yl,Qy⟩⟩∈?r^*" by auto
    let ?U = "⋃{?tc`⟨u,Last(yl)⟩. u∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Qy)}"
    have step:"⟨⟨yl,Qy⟩,⟨Init(yl),ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,?U)⟩⟩∈?r"
      unfolding FullNFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin valid] using yz(1) Q(1) by auto
    with Q(3) have A1:"⟨⟨w,P0⟩,⟨Init(yl),ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,?U)⟩⟩∈?r^*" using rtrancl_into_rtrancl by auto
    from yz(1) have lastSig:"Last(yl)∈Σ" using last_type by auto
    from fin A yz(2) lastSig have tys:"?tc`⟨ys,Last(yl)⟩ = {t`⟨ys,Last(yl)⟩}"
      using start_eNFSA_trans_symbol by auto
    from Q(1) have QyS:"Qy⊆?SS" by auto
    have unionSS:"?U ⊆ ?SS"
    proof
      fix x assume "x∈?U"
      then obtain ss where ss:"ss∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Qy)" "x∈?tc`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩" by auto
      from ss(1) cl_sub[OF QyS] have ssS:"ss∈?SS" by auto
      from lastSig have "Last(yl)∈succ(Σ)" by auto
      with ssS have "⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩∈?SS×succ(Σ)" by auto
      from apply_type[OF tT this] ss(2) show "x∈?SS" by auto
    qed
    have "t`⟨ys,Last(yl)⟩∈{t`⟨ys,Last(yl)⟩}" by auto
    moreover from Q(2) have
      "(?tc`⟨ys,Last(yl)⟩) ⊆ ?U" by auto
    moreover note tys
    ultimately have xU:"t`⟨ys,Last(yl)⟩∈?U" by auto
    have refl1:"?U ⊆ ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,?U)" using epsilon_cl_refl_sub[OF fin valid unionSS] by auto
    from unionSS have QSS:"ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,?U) ⊆ ?SS" using cl_sub by auto
    then have refl2:"ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,?U) ⊆ ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,?U))"
      using epsilon_cl_refl_sub[OF fin valid] by auto
    from xU refl1 refl2 have mem:"t`⟨ys,Last(yl)⟩∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,?U))" by auto
    from QSS have Qnew:"ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,?U)∈Pow(?SS)" by auto
    from Qnew mem A1 yz(4) show "∃Q∈Pow(?SS). snd(z)∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q) ∧ ⟨⟨w,P0⟩,⟨fst(z),Q⟩⟩∈?r^*"
      by auto
  qed
  then show ?thesis by auto
qed

text‹In particular, an execution of the DFSA on a nonempty word is simulated by start-eNFSA
  started at the new state $S$.›

lemma start_eNFSA_simulates_DFSA:
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)" and A:"(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and run:"⟨⟨w,s0⟩,⟨r,q⟩⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ)^*"
  and wne:"w∈NELists(Σ)"
  shows "∃Q∈Pow(start_eNFSA_states(S)). q∈ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S),start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),Σ,Q) ∧
    ⟨⟨w,{S}⟩,⟨r,Q⟩⟩∈({reduce ε-N-relation}(start_eNFSA_states(S),start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)){in alphabet}Σ)^*"
proof-
  have SPow:"{S}∈Pow(start_eNFSA_states(S))" unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def by auto
  have "ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S),start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),Σ,{S}) = {S,s0}"
    using epsilon_cl_F_in_cl_S[OF fin A] by auto
  then have s0P:"s0∈ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S),start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),Σ,{S})" by auto
  show ?thesis using start_eNFSA_simulates_DFSA_from[OF fin A run wne SPow s0P] by auto
qed


text‹Every word accepted by the original DFSA is accepted by start-eNFSA: the empty word
  is accepted because the $\epsilon$-closure of the initial state $S$ contains $S$, and for a
  nonempty word the DFSA execution is simulated by start-eNFSA, after the initial
  $\epsilon$-move to $s_0$.›

lemma L_subset_eNFSA_lang:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  shows "{w ∈ Lists(Σ). w <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ}
         ⊆ {w ∈ Lists(Σ). w <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S), S,
                                start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ}"
proof
  fix w assume w_in_L:"w ∈ {w ∈ Lists(Σ). w <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ}"
  then have w_type:"w ∈ Lists(Σ)" "w <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ" by auto
  have valid_eNFSA:"(start_eNFSA_states(S), S, start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), F∪{S}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    using start_eNFSA_valid[OF assms(1,2)] by auto
  show "w ∈ {w ∈ Lists(Σ). w <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S), S,
    start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ}"
  proof(cases "w=0")
    case True
    then show ?thesis using empty_in_eNFSA_lang assms by auto
  next
    case False
    with w_type(1) have wne:"w∈NELists(Σ)" using non_zero_List_func_is_NEList by auto
    from w_type(2) w_type(1) have "(∃q∈F. ⟨⟨w,s0⟩,⟨0,q⟩⟩ ∈ ({reduce D-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ)^*) ∨ (w = 0 ∧ s0∈F)"
      using DFSASatisfy_def[OF assms(1) assms(2) w_type(1)] by auto
    with False obtain q where q:"q∈F" "⟨⟨w,s0⟩,⟨0,q⟩⟩ ∈ ({reduce D-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ)^*" by auto
    obtain Q where Q:"Q∈Pow(start_eNFSA_states(S))"
      "q∈ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S),start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),Σ,Q)"
      "⟨⟨w,{S}⟩,⟨0,Q⟩⟩∈({reduce ε-N-relation}(start_eNFSA_states(S),start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)){in alphabet}Σ)^*"
      using start_eNFSA_simulates_DFSA[OF assms(1,2) q(2) wne] by blast
    from q(1) Q(2) have "ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S),start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),Σ,Q)∩(F∪{S}) ≠ 0" by auto
    then have "w <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S), S, start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ), F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ"
      unfolding FullNFSASatisfy_def[OF assms(1) valid_eNFSA w_type(1)] using Q by blast
    with w_type(1) show ?thesis by auto
  qed
qed


text‹Prepending a word of $L$, or the empty word, to a word of $L^*$ gives a word of $L^*$.›

lemma star_prepend:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "L {is a language with alphabet}Σ" "x∈L∪{0}" "c∈(L*⇧Σ)"
  shows "Concat(x,c)∈(L*⇧Σ)"
proof-
  have "0:0→Σ" unfolding Pi_def function_def by auto
  then have l0:"0∈Lists(Σ)" unfolding Lists_def by blast
  from assms(4) have c:"c∈Lists(Σ)" "⟨0,c⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*" using star_def assms(1,2) by auto
  have xL:"x∈Lists(Σ)"
  proof(cases "x=0")
    case True
    with l0 show ?thesis by auto
  next
    case False
    with assms(3) have "x∈L" by auto
    with assms(1,2) show ?thesis using IsALanguage_def by auto
  qed
  have cc:"Concat(x,c)∈Lists(Σ)" using concat_type xL c(1) by auto
  from c(1) cc have "⟨c,Concat(x,c)⟩∈Lists(Σ)×Lists(Σ)" by auto
  moreover from assms(3) have "∃y∈L∪{0}. Concat(x,c) = Concat(y,c)" by auto
  ultimately have "⟨c,Concat(x,c)⟩ ∈ {⟨v,w⟩∈Lists(Σ)×Lists(Σ). ∃y∈L∪{0}. w = Concat(y,v)}" by auto
  then have "⟨c,Concat(x,c)⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)" using R_lang_def assms(1,2) by auto
  with c(2) have "⟨0,Concat(x,c)⟩∈R_lang(L,Σ)^*" using rtrancl_into_rtrancl by auto
  with cc show ?thesis using star_def assms(1,2) by auto
qed

text‹If $x$ is a word accepted by the DFSA and $v$ is a word accepted by start-eNFSA,
  then the concatenation $x\cdot v$ is accepted by start-eNFSA. The automaton reads $v$ first,
  then restarts at $s_0$ thanks to the $\epsilon$-transition from an accepting state, and then reads $x$.›

lemma concat_L_eNFSA_lang:
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)" and A:"(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and x:"x∈Lists(Σ)" "x <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ"
  and v:"v∈Lists(Σ)"
    "v <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ"
  shows "Concat(x,v) <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ"
proof-
  let ?SS = "start_eNFSA_states(S)"
  let ?tc = "start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)"
  let ?R = "{reduce ε-N-relation}(?SS,?tc){in alphabet}Σ"
  let ?rD = "{reduce D-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ"
  have valid:"(?SS,S,?tc,F∪{S}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    using start_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A] by auto
  have CL:"Concat(x,v)∈Lists(Σ)" using concat_type x(1) v(1) by auto
  have SPow:"{S}∈Pow(?SS)" unfolding start_eNFSA_states_def by auto
  show ?thesis
  proof(cases "x=0")
    case True
    have "Concat(0,v) = v" using concat_empty(2) v(1) unfolding Lists_def by auto
    with True v(2) show ?thesis by auto
  next
    case xne:False
    show ?thesis
    proof(cases "v=0")
      case True
      have e1:"Concat(x,0) = x" using concat_empty(1) x(1) unfolding Lists_def by auto
      have e2:"x∈{w∈Lists(Σ). w <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ}" using x by auto
      have e3:"x∈{w∈Lists(Σ). w <-ε-N (?SS,S,?tc,F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ}"
        using L_subset_eNFSA_lang[OF fin A] e2 by auto
      from e3 have "x <-ε-N (?SS,S,?tc,F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ" by auto
      with e1 True show ?thesis by auto
    next
      case vne:False
      from v(2) have acc:"(∃Q∈Pow(?SS). ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q)∩(F∪{S})≠0 ∧ ⟨⟨v,{S}⟩,⟨0,Q⟩⟩∈?R^*)
        ∨ (v=0 ∧ ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,{S})∩(F∪{S})≠0)"
        using FullNFSASatisfy_def[OF fin valid v(1)] by auto
      with vne obtain Q where Q:"Q∈Pow(?SS)" "ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q)∩(F∪{S})≠0"
        "⟨⟨v,{S}⟩,⟨0,Q⟩⟩∈?R^*" by auto
      have vNE:"v∈NELists(Σ)" using non_zero_List_func_is_NEList v(1) vne by auto
      have xNE:"x∈NELists(Σ)" using non_zero_List_func_is_NEList x(1) xne by auto
      have lift:"⟨⟨Concat(x,v),{S}⟩,⟨Concat(x,0),Q⟩⟩∈?R^*"
        using eps_nfsa_run_prefix[OF fin valid Q(3) vNE SPow x(1)] by auto
      have c0:"Concat(x,0) = x" using concat_empty(1) x(1) unfolding Lists_def by auto
      with lift have lift2:"⟨⟨Concat(x,v),{S}⟩,⟨x,Q⟩⟩∈?R^*" by auto
      from x(2) have dacc:"(∃f∈F. ⟨⟨x,s0⟩,⟨0,f⟩⟩∈?rD^*) ∨ (x=0 ∧ s0∈F)"
        using DFSASatisfy_def[OF fin A x(1)] by auto
      with xne obtain f where f:"f∈F" "⟨⟨x,s0⟩,⟨0,f⟩⟩∈?rD^*" by auto
      from Q(2) have "∃e. e∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q)∩(F∪{S})" by auto
      then obtain e where e:"e∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q)" "e∈F∪{S}" by auto
      from Q(1) have QS:"Q⊆?SS" by auto
      have clQS:"ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q)⊆?SS" using start_eNFSA_cl_subset[OF fin A QS] by auto
      have "s0∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q))"
        using start_eNFSA_s0_in_cl[OF fin A clQS e(1) e(2)] by auto
      moreover have "ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q)) = ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q)"
        using epsilon_cl_idem[OF fin valid Q(1)] by auto
      ultimately have s0cl:"s0∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q)" by auto
      obtain Q2 where Q2:"Q2∈Pow(?SS)" "f∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q2)" "⟨⟨x,Q⟩,⟨0,Q2⟩⟩∈?R^*"
        using start_eNFSA_simulates_DFSA_from[OF fin A f(2) xNE Q(1) s0cl] by blast
      from lift2 Q2(3) have comp:"⟨⟨Concat(x,v),{S}⟩,⟨0,Q2⟩⟩∈?R^*"
        using trans_rtrancl unfolding trans_def by auto
      from Q2(2) f(1) have clne:"ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q2)∩(F∪{S})≠0" by auto
      show ?thesis unfolding FullNFSASatisfy_def[OF fin valid CL] using Q2(1) clne comp by blast
    qed
  qed
qed

text‹The Kleene star of the language of the DFSA is contained in the language
  accepted by start-eNFSA. We follow the construction of $L^*$: the empty word is accepted and
  prepending a word of $L$ to an accepted word gives an accepted word.›

lemma star_subset_eNFSA_lang:
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)" and A:"(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  shows "({u∈Lists(Σ). u <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ}*⇧Σ) ⊆
    {w∈Lists(Σ). w <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ}"
proof
  let ?L = "{u∈Lists(Σ). u <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ}"
  let ?M = "{w∈Lists(Σ). w <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ}"
  have langL:"?L {is a language with alphabet}Σ" unfolding IsALanguage_def[OF fin] by auto
  fix x assume x:"x∈(?L*⇧Σ)"
  from x have xx:"x∈Lists(Σ)" "⟨0,x⟩∈R_lang(?L,Σ)^*" using star_def fin langL by auto
  show "x∈?M"
  proof(rule rtrancl_induct[OF xx(2), where P="λy. y∈?M"])
    show "0∈?M" using empty_in_eNFSA_lang[OF fin A] by auto
  next
    fix y z assume as:"⟨0,y⟩∈R_lang(?L,Σ)^*" "⟨y,z⟩∈R_lang(?L,Σ)" "y∈?M"
    from as(2) obtain q where q:"z=Concat(q,y)" "q∈?L∪{0}" "y∈Lists(Σ)" "z∈Lists(Σ)"
      using R_lang_def fin langL by auto
    from as(3) have yM:"y <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ"
      by auto
    show "z∈?M"
    proof(cases "q=0")
      case True
      have "Concat(0,y) = y" using concat_empty(2) q(3) unfolding Lists_def by auto
      with True q(1) as(3) show ?thesis by auto
    next
      case False
      with q(2) have qL:"q∈?L" by auto
      then have qq1:"q∈Lists(Σ)" and qq2:"q <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ" by auto
      have "Concat(q,y) <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ"
        using concat_L_eNFSA_lang[OF fin A qq1 qq2 q(3) yM] by auto
      with q(1,4) show ?thesis by auto
    qed
  qed
qed

text‹To show the converse inclusion we follow an execution of start-eNFSA on a word $w$. The predicate
  start-eNFSA-wit says that, after reading a suffix of $w$ and leaving $r$ unread, the state $x$ was reached
  as follows: $w=rr\cdot c$ where $c\in L^*$ is the part of the word that was read before the last restart
  at $s_0$, and the DFSA run on $rr$ from $s_0$ has reached the state $x$ with $r$ unread.›

definition start_eNFSA_wit where
  "start_eNFSA_wit(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,r,x) ≡
   ∃rr∈Lists(Σ). ∃c∈({u∈Lists(Σ). u <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ}*⇧Σ).
     w=Concat(rr,c) ∧ ((rr=r ∧ x=s0) ∨ ⟨⟨rr,s0⟩,⟨r,x⟩⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ)^*)"

text‹The invariant of an execution of start-eNFSA: every state in the $\epsilon$-closure of the current
  set of states $Q$ is either the new state $S$ (before anything was read) or a state of the DFSA
  reached in the way described by start-eNFSA-wit.›

definition start_eNFSA_inv where
  "start_eNFSA_inv(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,r,Q) ≡ Q∈Pow(start_eNFSA_states(S)) ∧
   (∀x∈ε-cl(start_eNFSA_states(S),start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),Σ,Q).
     (x=S ∧ r=w) ∨ (x∈S ∧ start_eNFSA_wit(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,r,x)))"

text‹Introduction rule for start-eNFSA-wit.›

lemma start_eNFSA_wit_intro:
  assumes "rr∈Lists(Σ)" "c∈({u∈Lists(Σ). u <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ}*⇧Σ)" "w=Concat(rr,c)"
    "(rr=r ∧ x=s0) ∨ ⟨⟨rr,s0⟩,⟨r,x⟩⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ)^*"
  shows "start_eNFSA_wit(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,r,x)"
  unfolding start_eNFSA_wit_def using assms by blast

text‹Every word accepted by start-eNFSA belongs to the Kleene star of the language of the DFSA.›

lemma eNFSA_lang_subset_star:
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)" and A:"(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  shows "{w∈Lists(Σ). w <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ}
    ⊆ ({u∈Lists(Σ). u <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ}*⇧Σ)"
proof
  let ?SS = "start_eNFSA_states(S)"
  let ?tc = "start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ)"
  let ?R = "{reduce ε-N-relation}(?SS,?tc){in alphabet}Σ"
  let ?rD = "{reduce D-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ"
  let ?L = "{u∈Lists(Σ). u <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ}"
  let ?Ls = "(?L)*⇧Σ"
  have valid:"(?SS,S,?tc,F∪{S}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    using start_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A] by auto
  have SSdef:"?SS = succ(S)" by (simp add: start_eNFSA_states_def)
  from A have s0S:"s0∈S" using DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have langL:"?L {is a language with alphabet}Σ" unfolding IsALanguage_def[OF fin] by auto
  have D:"DetFinStateAuto(S,s0,t,F,Σ)" unfolding DetFinStateAuto_def using fin A by auto
  have empty0:"0∈?Ls" using empty_star fin langL by auto
  have SnotS:"S∉S" using mem_not_refl by auto
  have SPow:"{S}∈Pow(?SS)" using SSdef by auto
  fix w assume wM:"w∈{u∈Lists(Σ). u <-ε-N (?SS,S,?tc,F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ}"
  then have wL:"w∈Lists(Σ)" and wacc:"w <-ε-N (?SS,S,?tc,F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ" by auto
  show "w∈?Ls"
  proof(cases "w=0")
    case True
    with empty0 show ?thesis by auto
  next
    case wne:False
    from wacc have acc:"(∃Q∈Pow(?SS). ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q)∩(F∪{S})≠0 ∧ ⟨⟨w,{S}⟩,⟨0,Q⟩⟩∈?R^*)
      ∨ (w=0 ∧ ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,{S})∩(F∪{S})≠0)"
      using FullNFSASatisfy_def[OF fin valid wL] by auto
    with wne obtain Q where Q:"Q∈Pow(?SS)" "ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q)∩(F∪{S})≠0"
      "⟨⟨w,{S}⟩,⟨0,Q⟩⟩∈?R^*" by auto
    have claim:"∀r' Q'. ⟨0,Q⟩=⟨r',Q'⟩ ⟶ start_eNFSA_inv(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,r',Q')"
    proof(rule rtrancl_induct[OF Q(3), where P="λy. ∀r' Q'. y=⟨r',Q'⟩ ⟶ start_eNFSA_inv(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,r',Q')"])
      show "∀r' Q'. ⟨w,{S}⟩=⟨r',Q'⟩ ⟶ start_eNFSA_inv(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,r',Q')"
      proof(intro allI impI)
        fix r' Q' assume eq:"⟨w,{S}⟩=⟨r',Q'⟩"
        then have e:"r'=w" "Q'={S}" by auto
        have clS:"ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,{S}) = {S,s0}" using epsilon_cl_F_in_cl_S[OF fin A] by auto
        have "∀x∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q'). (x=S ∧ r'=w) ∨ (x∈S ∧ start_eNFSA_wit(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,r',x))"
        proof(rule ballI)
          fix x assume x:"x∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q')"
          with e(2) clS have "x=S ∨ x=s0" by auto
          then show "(x=S ∧ r'=w) ∨ (x∈S ∧ start_eNFSA_wit(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,r',x))"
          proof
            assume "x=S"
            with e(1) show ?thesis by auto
          next
            assume xs:"x=s0"
            have c3:"w = Concat(w,0)" using concat_empty(1) wL unfolding Lists_def by auto
            have d4:"(w=r' ∧ x=s0) ∨ ⟨⟨w,s0⟩,⟨r',x⟩⟩∈?rD^*" using e(1) xs by auto
            have "start_eNFSA_wit(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,r',x)"
              using start_eNFSA_wit_intro[OF wL empty0 c3 d4] by auto
            moreover from xs s0S have "x∈S" by auto
            ultimately show ?thesis by auto
          qed
        qed
        moreover from e(2) SPow have "Q'∈Pow(?SS)" by auto
        ultimately show "start_eNFSA_inv(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,r',Q')" unfolding start_eNFSA_inv_def by auto
      qed
    next
      fix y z assume as:"⟨⟨w,{S}⟩,y⟩∈?R^*" "⟨y,z⟩∈?R"
        "∀r' Q'. y=⟨r',Q'⟩ ⟶ start_eNFSA_inv(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,r',Q')"
      from as(2) obtain yl Qy where yz:"yl∈NELists(Σ)" "Qy∈Pow(?SS)" "y=⟨yl,Qy⟩"
        "z=⟨Init(yl),ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,⋃{?tc`⟨u,Last(yl)⟩. u∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Qy)})⟩"
        unfolding FullNFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin valid] by auto
      let ?U = "⋃{?tc`⟨u,Last(yl)⟩. u∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Qy)}"
      have I:"start_eNFSA_inv(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,yl,Qy)" using as(3) yz(3) by auto
      have Ic:"∀s∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Qy). (s=S ∧ yl=w) ∨ (s∈S ∧ start_eNFSA_wit(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,yl,s))"
        using I unfolding start_eNFSA_inv_def by auto
      have lastSig:"Last(yl)∈Σ" using last_type yz(1) by auto
      have InitL:"Init(yl)∈Lists(Σ)" using init_NElist(1)[OF yz(1)] by auto
      from yz(2) have QyS:"Qy⊆?SS" by auto
      have clQy:"ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Qy)⊆?SS" using start_eNFSA_cl_subset[OF fin A QyS] by auto
      have US:"?U⊆S"
      proof
        fix x assume "x∈?U"
        then obtain s where s:"s∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Qy)" "x∈?tc`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩" by auto
        from s(1) clQy have "s∈?SS" by auto
        with SSdef have sSucc:"s∈succ(S)" by auto
        from start_eNFSA_trans_symbol_sub[OF fin A sSucc lastSig] s(2) show "x∈S" by auto
      qed
      have USS:"?U⊆?SS" using US SSdef by auto
      then have USP:"?U∈Pow(?SS)" by auto
      have idem:"ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,?U)) = ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,?U)"
        using epsilon_cl_idem[OF fin valid USP] by auto
      have clU:"ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,?U)∈Pow(?SS)" using start_eNFSA_cl_subset[OF fin A USS] by auto
      have ext:"∀s∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Qy). ∀x∈?tc`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩.
        ∃rr∈Lists(Σ). ∃c∈?Ls. w=Concat(rr,c) ∧ ⟨⟨rr,s0⟩,⟨Init(yl),x⟩⟩∈?rD^*"
      proof(intro ballI)
        fix s x assume s:"s∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Qy)" and x:"x∈?tc`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩"
        from s clQy have "s∈?SS" by auto
        with SSdef have sSucc:"s∈succ(S)" by auto
        then have "s=S ∨ s∈S" by auto
        then show "∃rr∈Lists(Σ). ∃c∈?Ls. w=Concat(rr,c) ∧ ⟨⟨rr,s0⟩,⟨Init(yl),x⟩⟩∈?rD^*"
        proof
          assume sS:"s=S"
          then have "?tc`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩ = 0" using start_eNFSA_trans_symbol_S[OF fin A lastSig] by auto
          with x show ?thesis by auto
        next
          assume sS:"s∈S"
          have tcs:"?tc`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩ = {t`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩}"
            using start_eNFSA_trans_symbol[OF fin A sS lastSig] by auto
          with x have xe:"x=t`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩" by auto
          from Ic s have "(s=S ∧ yl=w) ∨ (s∈S ∧ start_eNFSA_wit(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,yl,s))" by auto
          with sS SnotS have W:"start_eNFSA_wit(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,yl,s)" by auto
          from W obtain rr c where rc:"rr∈Lists(Σ)" "c∈?Ls" "w=Concat(rr,c)"
            "(rr=yl ∧ s=s0) ∨ ⟨⟨rr,s0⟩,⟨yl,s⟩⟩∈?rD^*"
            unfolding start_eNFSA_wit_def by auto
          have stepD:"⟨⟨yl,s⟩,⟨Init(yl),t`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩⟩⟩∈?rD"
            unfolding DFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin A] using yz(1) sS by auto
          have run2:"⟨⟨rr,s0⟩,⟨Init(yl),t`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩⟩⟩∈?rD^*"
          proof(cases "rr=yl ∧ s=s0")
            case True
            with stepD show ?thesis using r_into_rtrancl by auto
          next
            case False
            with rc(4) have "⟨⟨rr,s0⟩,⟨yl,s⟩⟩∈?rD^*" by auto
            with stepD show ?thesis using rtrancl_into_rtrancl by auto
          qed
          from rc(1,2,3) run2 xe show ?thesis by blast
        qed
      qed
      show "∀r' Q'. z=⟨r',Q'⟩ ⟶ start_eNFSA_inv(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,r',Q')"
      proof(intro allI impI)
        fix r' Q' assume zz:"z=⟨r',Q'⟩"
        with yz(4) have e:"r'=Init(yl)" "Q'=ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,?U)" by auto
        have "∀x∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q'). (x=S ∧ r'=w) ∨ (x∈S ∧ start_eNFSA_wit(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,r',x))"
        proof(rule ballI)
          fix x assume x:"x∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q')"
          with e(2) idem have xU:"x∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,?U)" by auto
          from start_eNFSA_cl_upper[OF fin A US xU] have xcases:"x∈?U ∨ (x=s0 ∧ ?U∩F≠0)" by auto
          then show "(x=S ∧ r'=w) ∨ (x∈S ∧ start_eNFSA_wit(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,r',x))"
          proof
            assume xu:"x∈?U"
            then obtain s where s:"s∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Qy)" "x∈?tc`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩" by auto
            have exx:"∃rr∈Lists(Σ). ∃c∈?Ls. w=Concat(rr,c) ∧ ⟨⟨rr,s0⟩,⟨Init(yl),x⟩⟩∈?rD^*"
              using bspec[OF bspec[OF ext s(1)] s(2)] by auto
            then obtain rr c where rc:"rr∈Lists(Σ)" "c∈?Ls" "w=Concat(rr,c)"
              "⟨⟨rr,s0⟩,⟨Init(yl),x⟩⟩∈?rD^*" by auto
            have d4:"(rr=r' ∧ x=s0) ∨ ⟨⟨rr,s0⟩,⟨r',x⟩⟩∈?rD^*" using rc(4) e(1) by auto
            have "start_eNFSA_wit(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,r',x)"
              using start_eNFSA_wit_intro[OF rc(1,2,3) d4] by auto
            moreover from xu US have "x∈S" by auto
            ultimately show ?thesis by auto
          next
            assume xs:"x=s0 ∧ ?U∩F≠0"
            then have "∃f. f∈(?U∩F)" by blast
            then obtain f where f:"f∈?U" "f∈F" by auto
            then obtain s where s:"s∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Qy)" "f∈?tc`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩" by auto
            have exx:"∃rr∈Lists(Σ). ∃c∈?Ls. w=Concat(rr,c) ∧ ⟨⟨rr,s0⟩,⟨Init(yl),f⟩⟩∈?rD^*"
              using bspec[OF bspec[OF ext s(1)] s(2)] by auto
            then obtain rr c where rc:"rr∈Lists(Σ)" "c∈?Ls" "w=Concat(rr,c)"
              "⟨⟨rr,s0⟩,⟨Init(yl),f⟩⟩∈?rD^*" by auto
            have cL:"c∈Lists(Σ)" using rc(2) star_def fin langL by auto
            have "∃j∈Lists(Σ). rr=Concat(Init(yl),j)"
              using DetFinStateAuto.list_prefix_split[OF D rc(4)] by auto
            then obtain j where j:"j∈Lists(Σ)" "rr=Concat(Init(yl),j)" by auto
            have jL:"j∈?L∪{0}"
            proof(cases "j=0")
              case True
              then show ?thesis by auto
            next
              case False
              from j(1) False have jNE:"j∈NELists(Σ)" using non_zero_List_func_is_NEList by auto
              from rc(4) j(2) have rj:"⟨⟨Concat(Init(yl),j),s0⟩,⟨Init(yl),f⟩⟩∈?rD^*" by auto
              from DetFinStateAuto.dfa_run_suffix[OF D InitL jNE rj]
              have "⟨⟨j,s0⟩,⟨0,f⟩⟩∈?rD^*" by auto
              then have "j <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ"
                unfolding DFSASatisfy_def[OF fin A j(1)] using f(2) by auto
              with j(1) show ?thesis by auto
            qed
            have c':"Concat(j,c)∈?Ls" using star_prepend[OF fin langL jL rc(2)] by auto
            have assoc:"Concat(Concat(Init(yl),j),c) = Concat(Init(yl),Concat(j,c))"
              using concat_assoc_lists[OF InitL j(1) cL] by auto
            from rc(3) j(2) assoc have wsplit:"w=Concat(Init(yl),Concat(j,c))" by auto
            have d4:"(Init(yl)=r' ∧ x=s0) ∨ ⟨⟨Init(yl),s0⟩,⟨r',x⟩⟩∈?rD^*" using e(1) xs by auto
            have "start_eNFSA_wit(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,r',x)"
              using start_eNFSA_wit_intro[OF InitL c' wsplit d4] by auto
            moreover from xs s0S have "x∈S" by auto
            ultimately show ?thesis by auto
          qed
        qed
        moreover from e(2) clU have "Q'∈Pow(?SS)" by auto
        ultimately show "start_eNFSA_inv(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,r',Q')" unfolding start_eNFSA_inv_def by auto
      qed
    qed
    from claim have finInv:"start_eNFSA_inv(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,0,Q)" by auto
    from Q(2) have "∃e. e∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q)∩(F∪{S})" by auto
    then obtain e where e:"e∈ε-cl(?SS,?tc,Σ,Q)" "e∈F∪{S}" by auto
    from finInv e(1) have "(e=S ∧ 0=w) ∨ (e∈S ∧ start_eNFSA_wit(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,0,e))"
      unfolding start_eNFSA_inv_def by auto
    with wne SnotS e(2) have W:"start_eNFSA_wit(S,s0,t,F,Σ,w,0,e)" and eF:"e∈F" by auto
    from W obtain rr c where rc:"rr∈Lists(Σ)" "c∈?Ls" "w=Concat(rr,c)"
      "(rr=0 ∧ e=s0) ∨ ⟨⟨rr,s0⟩,⟨0,e⟩⟩∈?rD^*"
      unfolding start_eNFSA_wit_def by auto
    have rrL:"rr∈?L∪{0}"
    proof(cases "rr=0")
      case True
      then show ?thesis by auto
    next
      case False
      with rc(4) have "⟨⟨rr,s0⟩,⟨0,e⟩⟩∈?rD^*" by auto
      then have "rr <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ"
        unfolding DFSASatisfy_def[OF fin A rc(1)] using eF by auto
      with rc(1) show ?thesis by auto
    qed
    show ?thesis using star_prepend[OF fin langL rrL rc(2)] rc(3) by auto
  qed
qed

text‹The main result: the language accepted by start-eNFSA is the Kleene star of the language
  accepted by the DFSA.›

theorem start_eNFSA_lang_eq_star:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  shows "{w∈Lists(Σ). w <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ}
    = ({u∈Lists(Σ). u <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ}*⇧Σ)"
proof
  show "{w∈Lists(Σ). w <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ}
    ⊆ ({u∈Lists(Σ). u <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ}*⇧Σ)"
    using eNFSA_lang_subset_star[OF assms] by auto
  show "({u∈Lists(Σ). u <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ}*⇧Σ) ⊆
    {w∈Lists(Σ). w <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ}"
    using star_subset_eNFSA_lang[OF assms] by auto
qed

text‹As a consequence, the Kleene star of the language of a DFSA is a regular language.›

corollary star_language_is_regular:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  shows "({u∈Lists(Σ). u <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ}*⇧Σ) {is a regular language on}Σ"
proof-
  have valid:"(start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),F∪{S}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    using start_eNFSA_valid[OF assms] by auto
  have "{w∈Lists(Σ). w <-ε-N (start_eNFSA_states(S),S,start_eNFSA_trans(S,s0,t,F,Σ),F∪{S}){in alphabet}Σ}
    {is a regular language on}Σ"
    using epsilonNFSA_lang_is_regular[OF assms(1) valid] by auto
  then show ?thesis using start_eNFSA_lang_eq_star[OF assms] by auto
qed

text‹The Kleene star of a regular language is regular.›

corollary regular_star:
  assumes "Finite(Σ)" "L{is a regular language on}Σ"
  shows "(L*⇧Σ) {is a regular language on}Σ"
proof-
  from assms obtain S s0 t F where A:"(S,s0,t,F){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    and "L=DetFinStateAuto.LanguageDFSA(S,s0,t,F,Σ)"
    using IsRegularLanguage_def[OF assms(1)] by auto
  then have "L={u∈Lists(Σ). u <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ}" by auto
  moreover have "({u∈Lists(Σ). u <-D (S,s0,t,F){in alphabet}Σ}*⇧Σ) {is a regular language on}Σ"
    using star_language_is_regular[OF assms(1) A] by auto
  ultimately show ?thesis by auto
qed

end
